scores.rationale: Brand recognition of Google/IBM certificates, though completion-based
Guided projects exist; one source only
IBM certificate focuses on Python and SQL; Google's uses R
Estimates assume 10 h/week; at 5 h/week expect roughly twice as long
Described as more hands-on; single source
University brands, but one source says fewer industry certificates and accreditation claims conflict

recommendation.headline: Coursera's IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, paired with your own portfolio project
recommendation.summary: Best match for a recognised certificate and Python, but expect it to take longer than the 4-month estimate at 5 hours a week.

reasons.text: IBM certificate focuses on Python and SQL, unlike Google's R-based one
Google and IBM certificates carry strong brand recognition, though completion-based
Coursera partners with many universities and companies and offers guided projects

tradeoffs.text: Estimated 4 months is at 10 h/week; at 5 h/week expect about double (inference)

alternatives.when: You prioritise project-based Python and flexible pacing over certificate brand
You want bite-sized hands-on practice and do not need accreditation
You want a free or cheap Harvard CS50P intro to Python first

caveats: Sources are mostly vendor or low-reliability; no primary DataCamp or edX source

contradictions.topic: Number of courses in IBM certificate
contradictions.assessment: Coursera's page (2025) says 11; a 2024 personal blog says 9. Coursera is more authoritative and recent.
Upskillwise says accredited; Dataquest quotes Harvard CS50P as not accredited; Analytics Insight says fewer industry certificates. Treat edX accreditation as unverified.

uncertainties.text: DataCamp claims rest on one third-party article
